entries.proposition: COHORT: 20 consecutive smokers resected for OSCC, one hospital, Aug 2003-Jun 2004. DATO.
entries.snippet: Fresh tissue and blood samples were consecutively obtained from 20 smokers undergoing therapeutic surgical resection for OSCC at the Hospital Luxemburgo between August 2003 and June 2004.
entries.anchor: Material and methods > Human tissue, sentence 1

experimental_context.system: human tissue, primary oral squamous cell carcinoma (20 smokers) and normal oral mucosa

entries.proposition: CONTROLS: normal mucosa from volunteers without OSCC. Their number is not stated in the body; the abstract gives 10. DATO.
entries.snippet: Oral normal mucosa was obtained from volunteers without OSCC during non neoplastic or preprosthetic surgical procedures (control samples).
entries.anchor: Material and methods > Human tissue, sentence 3
entries.abstract_snippet: investigated in 20 tumors and 10 normal oral mucosas

experimental_context.system: human tissue, primary oral squamous cell carcinoma (20 smokers) and normal oral mucosa

entries.proposition: CONTROLS MATCHED for age, sex and smoking. DATO as stated; no table of the controls is given.
entries.snippet: The age, sex and smoking habits of the healthy volunteers were matched with patients.
entries.anchor: Material and methods > Human tissue, sentence 4

entries.proposition: RT-PCR IS NESTED: two rounds of 35 cycles each with 1 ul of round-one product as template. DATO. Seventy cycles on tumour cDNA is a condition under which recombination and template-switching artefacts are possible; none is excluded in the paper (INFERENZA, reader).
entries.snippet: One microliter of the amplification product from the first reaction was used for the second reaction under the same conditions stated earlier.
entries.anchor: Material and methods > Reverse transcription-PCR analysis

entries.proposition: ANTIBODY SPECIFICITY IS IMPORTED from ref 21 (Ludes-Meyers 2003): no cross-reactivity on homozygously deleted lines. Not re-tested here. DATO for the citation.
entries.snippet: This antiserum has no detectable crossreactivity with other cellular proteins as demonstrated by immunoblotting of total protein extracts from cell lines containing homozygous deletions of the WWOX gene.
entries.anchor: Material and methods > Western blot analyses

entries.proposition: PEPTIDE PRE-ADSORPTION ABOLISHED IHC SIGNAL: stated without a figure and without saying whether it was done in this study or in ref 21. DATO as a statement; provenance ambiguous.
entries.snippet: In addition, preadsorption of the antiserum to a GST fusion protein containing the WWOX WW domains completely eliminated immunohistochemical reactivity.
entries.anchor: Material and methods > Western blot analyses

entries.proposition: EPITOPE: antiserum raised against WWOX residues 12-94, i.e. the WW-domain region. DATO. That region is retained by an exon 6-8 deleted transcript, so a translated Delta6-8 product would carry the epitope (INFERENZA from the domain map; the size of such a product is not given in the paper).
entries.snippet: affinity purified polyclonal antiserum raised against Wwox amino acid residues 12–94 that recognizes conserved domains of the Wwox protein
entries.anchor: Results > Expression of Wwox protein, sentence 2

entries.proposition: IHC SCORING BY EXTENT ONLY, intensity ignored: +1 0-10%, +2 11-50%, +3 >50%; +3 = normal. Two pathologists, no agreement statistic, no blinding stated. DATO.
entries.snippet: Two experienced independent pathologists examined multiple fields and scored tissue sections for extent of staining, regardless of staining intensity (+1, 0–10% positive cells; +2, 11–50% positive cells; +3, greater than 50% positive cells).
entries.anchor: Material and methods > WWOX immunohistochemistry

entries.proposition: TABLE II FOOTNOTE gives the +3 cut-off as >51%, against >50% in the Methods. DATO; a one-point discrepancy with no case affected that can be shown.
entries.snippet: 11–50% positive cells; +3, >51% positive cells
entries.anchor: Table II footnote 2

entries.proposition: TRANSCRIPT ALTERATION: 7/20 (35%) tumours altered or absent. DATO.
entries.snippet: Seven of 20 cases (35%) showed altered or absent expression of WWOX gene.
entries.anchor: Results > Aberrant WWOX gene transcripts, sentence 2

experimental_context.system: human tissue, primary oral squamous cell carcinoma (20 smokers) and normal oral mucosa

entries.proposition: SEQUENCED PRODUCTS: exon 6-8 loss in #CA2, #CA5, #CA21, #CA24; exon 7 loss in #CA2; partial exon 8-9 loss in #CA12. DATO. The abstract counts exon 6-8 loss in 2 tumours plus 'exon 7 and exon 6-8' in 1 - three with Delta6-8 against four here.
entries.snippet: Sequence analysis of the RT-PCR products showed loss of exons 6–8 (#CA2, #CA5, #CA21 and #CA24) (Fig. 1b), and 2 new WWOX transcripts were detected, with loss of exon 7 (#CA2) (Fig. 1d) and partial loss of exons 8–9 (#CA12) (Fig. 1c).
entries.anchor: Results > Aberrant WWOX gene transcripts, sentence 7
entries.abstract_snippet: absence of exons 6–8 (2 tumors), exon 7 (1 tumor), exon 7 and exon 6–8 (1 tumor) and partial loss of exons 8 and 9 (1 tumor)

experimental_context.system: human tissue, primary oral squamous cell carcinoma (20 smokers) and normal oral mucosa

entries.proposition: CK19 POSITIVE in the two transcript-null tumours. DATO; the CK19 assay is not in the Methods.
entries.snippet: Both samples were positive for Cytokeratin 19 that was used as a marker of epithelial cells.
entries.anchor: Results > Aberrant WWOX gene transcripts, sentence 6

entries.proposition: LEGEND CLASSES: X = #CA2, Y = #CA12, Z = #CA2, #CA5, #CA12, #CA21, #CA24. DATO as printed; it places #CA12 in class Z (exon 6-8 loss), which the Results do not.
entries.snippet: Y (#CA12) and Z (#CA2, #CA5, #CA12, #CA21 and #CA24)
entries.anchor: Figure 1 legend, panel a

entries.proposition: FIGURE 1A, NATIVE PIXELS plus 2x view. Lanes Normal, CA2, CA3, CA5, CA11, CA12, CA18, CA21, CA24. #CA12 shows the ~1200 bp normal band and a second band just beneath it (the 'X and Y' level) and NO band at the Z level; Z bands are in CA2, CA5, CA21 and CA24 only. The panel agrees with the Results and contradicts the legend's inclusion of #CA12 in Z. CA3 and CA18 lanes blank with GAPDH present; CA11 shows only the normal band.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 1A: CA12 lane two closely spaced bands near 1200 bp, no band at the Z marker; Z band present in CA2, CA5, CA21, CA24; CA3 and CA18 empty above GAPDH.
entries.anchor: Figure 1A (PDF p.9), native raster 1524x1673; CA5-CA24 region also at 2x pixel replication

experimental_context.system: human tissue, primary oral squamous cell carcinoma (20 smokers) and normal oral mucosa

entries.proposition: FIGURE 1B-E, NATIVE PIXELS. Chromatograms: B exon 5 -> exon 9 junction; C exon 8* -> exon 9* (partial); D exon 6 -> exon 8 junction (exon 7 skipped); E single T peak at the arrowed position in T-A-C-T-T-C-A-A. Consistent with the sequence statements.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 1B-E: junction labels Exon 5 to Exon 9, Exon 8* to Exon 9*, Exon 6 to Exon 8; panel E arrow over a single T peak.
entries.anchor: Figure 1B-E (PDF p.9), native raster

entries.proposition: WESTERN: no product of the aberrant transcripts; authors favour 'not translated' over 'rapidly degraded'. DATO for 'not seen'; both explanations are INFERENZA (theirs), and neither was tested (no proteasome or lysosome inhibition, no in vitro translation).
entries.snippet: Products of the aberrant transcripts present in OSCC (#CA2, #CA5, #CA12, #CA21 and #CA24) were not seen, suggesting that these aberrant transcripts were not translated into protein or, less probably, that the proteins synthesized were being quickly degraded, making them undetectable (Fig. 2).
entries.anchor: Results > Expression of Wwox protein, sentence 4

experimental_context.system: human tissue, primary oral squamous cell carcinoma (20 smokers) and normal oral mucosa

entries.proposition: CAPTION: only 46 kDa wild-type protein detected. DATO as a statement.
entries.snippet: Only wild-type Wwox protein with 46 kDa was detected.
entries.anchor: Figure 2 legend

entries.proposition: FIGURE 2, NATIVE PIXELS plus 3x view. Twelve lanes: CA3, CA4, CA7, CA11, CA12, Normal | CA2, CA9, CA5, CA21, CA8, Normal - ten of twenty tumours; the text says all 20 were blotted. A faint 46 kDa band is visible in #CA3, whose RT-PCR detected no transcript, and in #CA5, whose only transcript is Delta6-8; β-actin is lighter in CA3 and CA11 and heaviest in CA21. The WWOX strip carries a single 46 kDa marker and no molecular-weight ladder, so whether a shorter product would fall inside the cropped strip cannot be established from the figure.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 2: lanes CA3 CA4 CA7 CA11 CA12 Normal and CA2 CA9 CA5 CA21 CA8 Normal; single band at 46kDa marker; faint in CA3, CA5, CA11; actin uneven; no size ladder on the WWOX strip.
entries.anchor: Figure 2 (PDF p.10), native raster 1258x349; left blot also at 3x pixel replication

experimental_context.system: human tissue, primary oral squamous cell carcinoma (20 smokers) and normal oral mucosa

entries.proposition: IHC: 8/20 (40%) reduced (five +2, three +1); all normals +3. DATO.
entries.snippet: Of the 20 OSCC tumors, 8 tumors (40%) showed a reduced expression to Wwox.
entries.anchor: Results > Expression of Wwox protein, paragraph 2

experimental_context.system: human tissue, primary oral squamous cell carcinoma (20 smokers) and normal oral mucosa

entries.proposition: CAPTION 3C: a few tumour cells positive, score +2 (#CA12). DATO as a statement.
entries.snippet: (c) OSCC tumor demonstrating a few tumor cells expressing the Wwox protein, score +2 (#CA12)
entries.anchor: Figure 3 legend, panel c

entries.proposition: FIGURE 3, NATIVE PIXELS (1248x809, four panels). A normal mucosa: brown cytoplasmic stain through the epithelium. B (#CA5): no brown stain. C (#CA12): a few brown cells, several of them elongated and spindle-shaped; whether they are tumour cells or stromal/inflammatory cells cannot be decided at this resolution. D (#CA24): granular brown cytoplasmic/membranous staining in many cells. Note '+2' is 11-50% of cells by the paper's own scale, and panel C does not look like 11% or more.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure 3: A brown cytoplasmic epithelium; B unstained tumour; C scattered brown elongated cells in unstained tumour; D widespread granular brown staining.
entries.anchor: Figure 3 (PDF p.11), native raster 1248x809

experimental_context.system: human tissue, primary oral squamous cell carcinoma (20 smokers) and normal oral mucosa

entries.proposition: CONCORDANCE: 5/7 transcript-altered tumours have reduced IHC. DATO; no test, and 3/13 tumours without transcript change are also reduced (Table II).
entries.snippet: the majority of tumors (5/7) with altered transcripts had a marked reduction in the expression of Wwox protein (Table II).
entries.anchor: Results > Expression of Wwox protein, paragraph 3

experimental_context.system: human tissue, primary oral squamous cell carcinoma (20 smokers) and normal oral mucosa

entries.proposition: #CA18: no transcript, IHC +2. DATO; discordant, attributed by the authors to separate tissue pieces.
entries.anchor: Table II, rows #CA17-#CA19 (the #CA18 row is the evidence)

entries.proposition: #CA21: normal + Delta6-8 transcript with IHC +3 (normal). DATO; a Delta6-8 transcript coexists with full staining.
entries.snippet: #CA21 N and aberrant Exon 6–8 deletion +3
entries.anchor: Table II, row #CA21

entries.proposition: MUTATION: C>T at codon 329 second position, S329F, exon 8, SDR domain. DATO; no functional test.
entries.snippet: There was a C to T transition at the second nucleotide of codon 329 (exon 8) in the SDR domain, that resulted in the substitution of Serine to Phenylalanine (Fig. 1e).
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX gene sequence mutation and variants, sentence 3

experimental_context.system: human tissue, primary oral squamous cell carcinoma (20 smokers) and normal oral mucosa

entries.proposition: ZYGOSITY: called homozygous in tumour #CA12. DATO as stated; no LOH assay is described, and tumour tissue contains normal cells.
entries.snippet: A unique somatic missense mutation (homozygous) was detected in tumor #CA12.
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX gene sequence mutation and variants, sentence 2

entries.proposition: SOMATIC STATUS: wild type in blood, data not shown. DATO.
entries.snippet: To confirm the somatic mutation, DNA from peripheral blood from this OSCC patient was examined and a wild-type sequence was present (data not shown).
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX gene sequence mutation and variants, sentence 4

entries.proposition: POPULATION CHECK: 30 unrelated germline DNAs; written 'C329T', which conflates codon number and nucleotide notation. DATO as printed.
entries.snippet: analysis of germline DNA from 30 unrelated subjects was performed to demonstrate that the C329T was not a polymorphism.
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX gene sequence mutation and variants, last sentence

entries.proposition: FIVE KNOWN VARIANTS called common polymorphisms not affecting WW or SDR critical residues. INFERENZA (theirs), resting on ref 23; no frequency data given.
entries.snippet: None of these alterations affect critical residues of the WW domains or the SDR domain and represent common polymorphisms.
entries.anchor: Results > WWOX gene sequence mutation and variants, sentence 6

entries.proposition: 'ALTERED IN 50%' COMBINES layers: 7 transcript-altered plus 3 IHC-reduced tumours with no genetic change (#CA10, #CA11, #CA16) = 10/20. DATO for the arithmetic (reconstructed from Table II); calling protein reduction without genetic change a gene alteration is the authors' framing.
entries.snippet: Analysis of DNA, RNA and protein data showed that WWOX is altered in 50% of OSCC tumors.
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph 2

experimental_context.system: human tissue, primary oral squamous cell carcinoma (20 smokers) and normal oral mucosa

entries.proposition: THREE TUMOURS reduced at protein level with no genetic abnormality. DATO.
entries.snippet: Three cases with reduced or missing protein expression (#CA10, #CA11 and #CA16) did not exhibit any abnormality at genetic level
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph 3

entries.proposition: DISCUSSION HARDENS the Results: 'evidence that the aberrant transcripts are not translated'. An author interpretation stated as a finding; the Results said 'suggesting ... or, less probably, ... quickly degraded'.
entries.snippet: We also provided, by Western blot, evidence that the aberrant transcripts are not translated into protein.
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph 2

entries.proposition: #CA21/#CA24 full IHC despite Delta6-8: explained as heterogeneity. INFERENZA (theirs), untested.
entries.snippet: strong (score +3) protein expression in 2 cases (#CA21, #CA24) with loss of exons 6–8 might be explained by the occurrence of heterogeneous expression.
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph 3

entries.proposition: 'CORRELATED' is used without any statistical test. DATO for the word; no test appears anywhere in the paper.
entries.snippet: the presence of alterations in mRNA transcription correlated with the reduced expression of Wwox protein in 5 cases (#CA2, #CA3, #CA5, #CA12 and #CA18).
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph 3

entries.proposition: 'LARGE SERIES' of 20 tumours. DATO as the authors' characterisation.
entries.snippet: The present study is the first to analyze a large series of OSCCs and normal oral mucosas, using all of the methods mentioned earlier.
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph 1

entries.proposition: CAUSAL CONCLUSION 'contributes to the carcinogenesis': not tested by any functional experiment. IPOTESI stated as conclusion.
entries.snippet: These results show that the WWOX gene is frequently altered in OSCC and contributes to the carcinogenesis processes in oral cancer.
entries.anchor: Discussion, last sentence
